services.name: Yoga Up®
services.desc: Eating & Drinking For your first class, try not to eat right before class. In fact, try to eat a light meal 2-3 hours before class. Food left in your stomach can make some people nauseous during class. We find that fruit works well since it digests quickly. Make sure you drink plenty of water before class. These are all just guidelines, as you get to know your body better, you will find what works for you! What to Wear Wear light, dry-weave fabrics and non-restrictive clothing. It is hot in there.
